novelty_flags.label: related_work and comparator_promise_table / ShiraniBayati2024CausalMP
novelty_flags.one_line: They attribute the published PNAS article to Theorems 4.1--4.2, Lemmas 12.3--12.4, and §3.5, but its published text labels the main results Theorems 1--2 in §3 and places the heuristic CI discussion in §2.5.

soundness_flags.label: def:cfse and thm:joint-cfse
soundness_flags.one_line: M_N, b_T, B_T, and hence Γ_T are described only as an unspecified stack and output of a handle, so the advertised covariance recursion is not a determinate mathematical object.

soundness_flags.label: ass:initial-iid and thm:joint-cfse
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition says only that initial rows are identically distributed, not independent or subject to a root-N empirical-law CLT; the stated class therefore permits common initial-row shocks that invalidate the asserted row-sum linearization.

soundness_flags.label: def:cfse, def:path-band, and thm:path-bands
soundness_flags.one_line: The counterfactual recursion starts from only E[Y_0] and Var(Y_0), replacing Y_0 by an independent Gaussian despite arbitrary P_0X; already at the first transition its mean is generally not E[g(Y_0,a,X)], so θ_T is not the model's all-treated-minus-none-treated path.

soundness_flags.label: def:path-band and thm:path-bands
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed feasible band uses S={t:(Ω_θ)tt>0}, an unknown population set, with no observable selection rule or separation condition; C_N is therefore not an observable procedure as defined.

Require independent initial rows (or an explicit initial empirical-process root-N condition) and define an observable treatment of zero-variance coordinates, such as a proved thresholding rule with a separation regime or a band that never divides by an unknown zero variance.
Correct all Shirani--Bayati theorem/section anchors to the published PNAS version and distinguish those locations from any differently numbered arXiv or supplementary-material version.
